tickets.subject: Charged twice for order A-20931
tickets.body: My card statement shows two charges.

tickets.body: Since last week I am signed out roughly every ten minutes.

tickets.body: The quote for 6 pallets came back at a parcel price.

tickets.subject: Charged twice on card
tickets.body: Two charges for one order.

tickets.body: Every order notification posts twice.

tickets.subject: Monthly report email is blank
tickets.body: The report email arrives with no body.

tickets.subject: Pagination skips a page in the orders list
tickets.body: Page 3 repeats page 2.
